analysis.summaryJa: このページは、物を説明するwhichの目的語穴を中心に、物の所有を表すwhose、会話的な前置詞残置、改まった前置詞＋whichを整理する。さらにlook upやturn offのような句動詞は一まとまりとして保ち、前置詞・副詞粒子だけをwhichの前へ移動しないことを学ぶ。
grammarPoints: 物が関係節の目的語になるときwhich＋主語＋動詞の語順になる
目的格whichの後ろにitなど同じ目的語を重ねない
物・組織の所有や部分はwhose＋名詞で表せる
会話的な形では関係する前置詞を節末に残せる
改まった形では前置詞＋whichを関係節の先頭に置ける
前置詞を前置した場合はthatを使えない
look up・turn off・pick upなどの句動詞は粒子を切り離さない
目的格whichは前置詞を前置しない場合に省略できることがある
visualEvidence: THINGギアが目的語穴と前置詞穴のソケットへはまり、whichが物を後続節へ運んでいる
whose＋名詞の所有タグが機械の部品や会社の設備を結んでいる
会話レーンでは前置詞が節末に残り、フォーマルエレベーターでは前置詞＋whichが先頭へ上がっている
look up・turn offなどの句動詞には分離禁止のロックが掛かっている
commonTraps: 目的格whichの後ろにitを重ねる
物の所有をwhich itsで表す
前置詞を前置したのにthatを使う
whereで表せる場所関係に余分な前置詞を残す
句動詞の粒子をwhichの前へ不自然に移す
目的格whichを節の主語と取り違える
whoseは人にしか使えないと思い込む

questions.prompt: The tablet ------- the receptionist uses for check-in needs a new battery.

choices.B: who
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 受付担当者がチェックインに使用するタブレットには新しい電池が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: the receptionist usesの目的語が欠け、物tabletをwhichで受けます。

questions.prompt: The supplier ------- warehouse has automated loading bays can ship overnight.

choices.B: whose
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 倉庫に自動荷役口がある仕入先は翌日配送ができます。
questions.explanationJa: supplierが所有するwarehouseをwhose＋名詞で表します。

questions.prompt: The checklist ------- the inspector referred to is attached to the report.

choices.B: where
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 検査員が参照したチェックリストは報告書に添付されています。
questions.explanationJa: refer toの目的語がchecklistで、toを節末に残す目的格whichです。

questions.prompt: The room in ------- confidential interviews are conducted is soundproof.

choices.B: where
choices.D: which

questions.explanationJa: 前置詞inを前へ出した改まった形ではwhichを使い、thatは使えません。

questions.prompt: The code ------- the technician looked up was no longer valid.

choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 技術者が調べたコードはもはや有効ではありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: look upは句動詞として一まとまりで、whichはlooked upの目的語です。

questions.prompt: The copier ------- control panel is cracked has been taken out of service.

choices.B: whose
choices.D: who

questions.explanationJa: 物copierの一部control panelをwhoseでつなぎます。

questions.prompt: The account ------- the payment was transferred to has been verified.

choices.B: who
choices.D: when

questions.explanationJa: transfer toの目的語accountをwhichで受け、toを節末に残します。

questions.prompt: The policy under ------- refunds are processed was revised last month.

choices.B: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 返金処理の根拠となる方針は先月改訂されました。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞underの目的語となる物policyをwhichで受けます。

questions.prompt: The switch ------- the operator turned off controls the ventilation fan.

choices.B: where
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 操作員が切ったスイッチは換気扇を制御します。
questions.explanationJa: turn offは句動詞で、offをwhichの前へ移さず一まとまりに保ちます。

questions.prompt: The conditions under ------- the warranty remains valid are listed online.

choices.B: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 保証が有効である条件はオンラインに記載されています。
questions.explanationJa: 改まった文でunder＋whichがconditionsと節を結びます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with which as the object.

choices.A: The brochure which the hotel mailed it is available in three languages.
choices.B: The brochure which mailed the hotel is available in three languages.
choices.C: The brochure which the hotel mailed is available in three languages.
choices.D: The brochure who the hotel mailed is available in three languages.

questions.translationJa: ホテルが郵送したパンフレットは3言語で用意されています。
questions.explanationJa: the hotel mailedの目的語の穴をwhichが示し、itは不要です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a machine’s component.

choices.A: The printer which its tray is empty displays a warning.
choices.B: The printer whose the tray is empty displays a warning.
choices.C: The printer who tray is empty displays a warning.
choices.D: The printer whose tray is empty displays a warning.

questions.translationJa: トレイが空のプリンターは警告を表示します。
questions.explanationJa: 物printerの部品trayはwhose＋名詞で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a stranded preposition.

choices.A: The platform which passengers are waiting on is temporarily closed.
choices.B: The platform where passengers are waiting on is temporarily closed.
choices.C: The platform which passengers are waiting on it is temporarily closed.
choices.D: The platform on that passengers are waiting is temporarily closed.

questions.translationJa: 乗客が待っているホームは一時閉鎖されています。
questions.explanationJa: wait onのonを節末に残し、whichを目的語として使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal sentence with a fronted preposition.

choices.A: The channel through that customers submit claims is encrypted.
choices.B: The channel through which customers submit claims is encrypted.
choices.C: The channel which through customers submit claims is encrypted.
choices.D: The channel through which customers submit claims through it is encrypted.

questions.translationJa: 顧客が請求を提出する経路は暗号化されています。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞throughを前置する改まった形ではwhichを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence keeping the phrasal verb together.

choices.A: The serial number up which I looked belongs to an older model.
choices.B: The serial number which I looked belongs up to an older model.
choices.C: The serial number which I looked up belongs to an older model.
choices.D: The serial number which I looked it up belongs to an older model.

questions.translationJa: 私が調べた製造番号は旧型モデルのものです。
questions.explanationJa: look upは句動詞なのでupをwhichの前へ移さず、目的語itも重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence keeping turn off together.

choices.A: The alarm off which the guard turned was malfunctioning.
choices.B: The alarm which the guard turned it off was malfunctioning.
choices.C: The alarm where the guard turned off was malfunctioning.
choices.D: The alarm which the guard turned off was malfunctioning.

questions.translationJa: 警備員が停止した警報器は故障していました。
questions.explanationJa: turn offの目的語をwhichで受け、offを動詞から切り離しません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with whose for an organization.

choices.A: We selected the carrier whose tracking system updates every minute.
choices.B: We selected the carrier which its tracking system updates every minute.
choices.C: We selected the carrier whose the tracking system updates every minute.
choices.D: We selected the carrier who tracking system updates every minute.

questions.translationJa: 追跡システムが毎分更新される運送会社を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: 会社carrierが所有するtracking systemをwhoseで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal sentence using on which.

choices.A: The date on that the contract takes effect is July 1.
choices.B: The date on which the contract takes effect is July 1.
choices.C: The date which on the contract takes effect is July 1.
choices.D: The date on which the contract takes effect on it is July 1.

questions.translationJa: 契約が発効する日は7月1日です。
questions.explanationJa: on the dateに相当する関係をon whichで改まって表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence without a redundant pronoun.

choices.A: The package which the courier picked it up has reached the depot.
choices.B: The package up which the courier picked has reached the depot.
choices.C: The package which the courier picked up has reached the depot.
choices.D: The package who the courier picked up has reached the depot.

questions.translationJa: 配達員が集荷した荷物は配送拠点に到着しました。
questions.explanationJa: pick upの目的語をwhichが受けるためitを置きません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence after a fronted preposition.

choices.A: The purpose for that the data is collected is explained below.
choices.B: The purpose which for the data is collected is explained below.
choices.C: The purpose for which the data is collected for it is explained below.
choices.D: The purpose for which the data is collected is explained below.

questions.translationJa: データを収集する目的は以下で説明されています。
questions.explanationJa: forの直後ではwhichを用い、thatは置けません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The form which Lena completed is on my desk.”

choices.A: The form completed Lena at my desk.
choices.B: Lena completed the form, and it is on my desk.
choices.D: The form is on a desk that Lena has not used.

questions.translationJa: レナが記入した書類は私の机の上にあります。
questions.explanationJa: whichはLena completedの目的語としてformを受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The machine whose cover is loose must be inspected.”

choices.A: The machine has a loose cover and must be inspected.
choices.B: The loose cover must inspect every machine.
choices.C: The machine inspected a cover belonging to someone else.
choices.D: The machine is loose because no cover exists.

questions.translationJa: カバーが緩んでいる機械は点検が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: whose coverはcoverがmachineの一部であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The chair which the guest sat on is broken.”

choices.A: The chair sat on a broken guest.
choices.B: The guest broke a chair without sitting.
choices.C: The guest sat beside the chair, which remained unused.
choices.D: The guest sat on the chair, and the chair is broken.

questions.translationJa: 宿泊客が座った椅子は壊れています。
questions.explanationJa: whichはsat onの目的語で、onは節末に残っています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The system through which payments are processed is secure.”

choices.A: The system processes security instead of payments.
choices.B: Payments are processed after the system is removed.
choices.C: Payments are processed through the system, and the system is secure.
choices.D: A secure payment passes around, not through, the system.

questions.translationJa: 支払いを処理するシステムは安全です。
questions.explanationJa: through whichはthrough the systemという経路・手段関係です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The number which I looked up was incorrect.”

choices.A: I looked upward and saw the correct number.
choices.B: I searched for the number in a reference source, and it was incorrect.
choices.C: The number searched for me and made an error.
choices.D: I corrected the number without checking it.

questions.translationJa: 私が調べた番号は誤っていました。
questions.explanationJa: look upは情報を調べる句動詞で、whichがその目的語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The device which the technician turned off is restarting.”

choices.A: The technician switched off the device, and it is restarting.
choices.B: The device turned away from the technician.
choices.C: The technician restarted a device that remained on.
choices.D: The device switched the technician off duty.

questions.translationJa: 技術者が電源を切った装置は再起動中です。
questions.explanationJa: turn offは「電源を切る」で、whichがdeviceを目的語として受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The company whose website was redesigned reported higher sales.”

choices.A: The website redesigned the company’s sales report.
choices.B: Higher sales purchased a redesigned company.
choices.C: The company redesigned a website belonging to another firm.
choices.D: The company’s website was redesigned, and the company reported higher sales.

questions.translationJa: ウェブサイトを再設計した会社は売上増を報告しました。
questions.explanationJa: whose websiteはwebsiteがcompanyのものであることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The room in which the samples are stored is locked.”

choices.A: The locked samples contain a room.
choices.B: The room stores a lock instead of samples.
choices.C: The samples are stored in the room, and the room is locked.
choices.D: The samples are stored outside the locked room.

questions.translationJa: サンプルが保管されている部屋は施錠されています。
questions.explanationJa: in whichはin the roomという場所関係を改まって表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The parcel which the driver picked up is insured.”

choices.A: The insured parcel picked up the driver.
choices.B: The driver collected the parcel, and the parcel is insured.
choices.C: The driver insured a parcel but did not collect it.
choices.D: The parcel was delivered before the driver arrived.

questions.translationJa: 運転手が集荷した小包には保険が掛けられています。
questions.explanationJa: pick upは「集荷する」で、whichがparcelを目的語として受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The standards under which we operate are strict.”

choices.B: We operate below a building called Standards.
choices.C: The standards stop us from operating entirely.
choices.D: We created standards after ending operations.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは厳格な基準の下で業務を行っています。
questions.explanationJa: under whichはunder the standardsという規則・条件の関係です。

questions.prompt: “Which tablet should I charge?” “The one ------- the receptionist uses for registration.”

choices.B: where
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 「どのタブレットを充電しますか」「受付担当者が登録に使うものです」
questions.explanationJa: the receptionist usesの目的語の穴にtabletが入るためwhichです。

questions.prompt: “Which copier needs repair?” “The machine ------- paper feeder keeps jamming.”

choices.B: where the
choices.D: who

questions.explanationJa: machineの部品paper feederをwhoseでつなぎます。

questions.prompt: “Which portal should customers use?” “The site ------- they submit claims through.”

choices.B: which
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 「顧客はどのポータルを使うべきですか」「請求を送信するサイトです」
questions.explanationJa: submit claims throughの目的語siteをwhichで受け、throughを節末に残します。

questions.prompt: “Where are the archived contracts?” “In the cabinet in ------- we keep original documents.”

choices.B: that
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 「保管済み契約書はどこですか」「原本文書を保管するキャビネットです」

questions.prompt: The reference number ------- the agent looked up belongs to a canceled order.

choices.B: who
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: 担当者が調べた参照番号は取り消された注文のものです。
questions.explanationJa: look upを一まとまりに保ち、whichを目的語として使います。

questions.prompt: The vehicle ------- rear camera is damaged must remain in the garage.

choices.B: where the
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 後方カメラが損傷している車両は車庫に置いたままにしなければなりません。
questions.explanationJa: vehicleの装備rear cameraをwhose＋名詞で表します。

questions.prompt: “Which outlet did the technician use?” “The socket ------- the monitor was plugged into.”

choices.B: which
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 「技術者はどのコンセントを使いましたか」「モニターが差し込まれていたソケットです」
questions.explanationJa: plug intoの目的語socketをwhichで受け、intoを節末に残します。

questions.prompt: The procedure according to ------- refunds are approved is being updated.

choices.B: that
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 返金を承認する手順は更新中です。
questions.explanationJa: according toのtoの目的語としてprocedureを受けるwhichが必要です。

questions.prompt: The monitor ------- the technician turned off has switched itself back on.

choices.B: who
choices.D: which

questions.explanationJa: turn offを分離せず、whichをその目的語として使います。

questions.prompt: The criteria by ------- applications are evaluated are published online.

choices.B: where
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 申請を評価する基準はオンラインで公開されています。
questions.explanationJa: 前置詞byを前置した改まった形ではwhichを使い、thatは使えません。
